title: Tesla Stock News (Oct 15, 2026): TSLA Falls 2.2% to $367.16
summary: Tesla closed at $367.16 on Oct 14, down 2.15% as the Nasdaq fell 1.88%. Barclays flags a possible SpaceX merger; NHTSA probes robotaxis.
body_markdown:
## Why Tesla Stock Fell


None of the sources reviewed for this article tied Wednesday's decline to a specific Tesla announcement, and the move tracked the Nasdaq-wide selloff in technology names. Two Tesla stories circulated around the session, though both were published after the closing bell.


According to[Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tesla-spacex-merger-could-announced-234757020.html) , Barclays wrote in a Wednesday note that a merger between Tesla and SpaceX could be announced as early as before Tesla's 2026 annual meeting, which must be held by December 6.


Barclays expects an all-stock structure in which SpaceX acquires Tesla, at roughly 0.7 SpaceX shares per Tesla share based on current market values, and said the deal would still need approval from both shareholder groups and antitrust review.


Separately, per[Simply Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/does-tesla-tsla-nhtsa-school-221707829.html) , the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has opened a safety investigation into Tesla's robotaxis and its Cybercab over alleged speeding in active school zones. The outlet said possible outcomes include software changes, recalls or limits on usage.


## TSLA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- According to Tesla's[third quarter 2026 production and deliveries release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001318605/000162828026064366/exhibit991111111.htm) filed with the SEC, the company delivered 486,532 vehicles in the quarter, including 478,237 Model 3/Y units.
- The robotaxi fleet is expanding. As reported by[Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/tesla-just-launched-cybercab-austin-202000011.html) , Texas DMV records showed 319 Cybercabs registered as of October 10, up from 45 when the Austin service launched on September 4.
- Barclays described vertical integration as the main value in a potential SpaceX combination, per Stocktwits.


### Risks


- The NHTSA school zone probe could lead to recalls, fines or restrictions on unsupervised operation near schools, according to Simply Wall St.
- Cybercabs make up 39% of Tesla's Austin robotaxi fleet but only about 11% of rides, Motley Fool reported, citing RobotaxiTracker data.
- Any SpaceX merger faces shareholder votes and antitrust review, and Barclays said a late announcement could make approval at the annual meeting more difficult.


Tesla's next confirmed event is its third quarter 2026 financial results, due after the market close on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, according to the company's SEC filing.
